math_checks.outcome: For a nonnegative chain complex C of abelian groups, I checked the stated Hom(C_N Delta^n,C) expression in degrees n=0 and n=1. Normalized chains of Delta^0 have one degree-0 generator, so chain maps are C_0. For Delta^1, let degree-0 vertices be v_0,v_1 and degree-1 edge e with d(e)=v_1-v_0. A chain map is determined by x_0,x_1 in C_0 and y in C_1 with d(y)=x_1-x_0, equivalently by (x_0,y) in C_0 direct-sum C_1. I also checked the variance: a simplex map Delta^m to Delta^n induces C_N Delta^m to C_N Delta^n, and precomposition gives Hom(C_N Delta^n,C) to Hom(C_N Delta^m,C), the required simplicial direction. These are local consistency checks of the transcribed formula, not a proof of Dold-Kan, an extension to every additive category, or verification of the historical claims.
